socket_path_proof.formula: For physical absolute P with no trailing slash: R=P+"/"+".tmpXXXXXX"; socket=R+"/hook-writers.sock". Byte length is B(P)+1+10+1+17=B(P)+29. Require socket bytes<108, hence B(P)<=78 for this exact default layout.

socket_path_proof.cwd: An absolute canonical P is invariant across existing Git current_dir(work) and Python/hook cwd. Preserve outer product-worktree cwd and all existing command cwd; no chdir shortcut.
